spans.s:
तवक तवक, अस्, आ, अम्, thine; (perhaps an
incorrect form for तावक.)
तावक तावक (fr. तव), अस्, ई, अम्, thy, thine.

तवक्षीर तवक्षीर (a corruption of त्वक्-
क्षीर), अम्, n. manna of bamboo (commonly Ta-
bāṣīr); a N. applied to a kind of extract of wheat,
barley, rice, &c., (or, according to some, a kind
[]
of milk and water), = पयः-क्षीर, यव-ज,
यवजोद्भव (commonly Toṣākṣīra); (ई), f. a
kind of Curcuma (गन्ध-पत्त्रा).
—तवक्षीर्य्-
एकपत्त्रिका, the single-leaved Tavakṣīrī, turmeric,
Curcuma Zedoaria.
तवर तवर, a particular high number.
तावर तावर, अम्, n. a bow-string.

तवराज तवराज, अस्, m. a sort of sugar
prepared from a species of Hedysarum (यवास-
शर्करा).
—तवराजोद्भव-खण्ड (˚ज-उद्˚),
अस्, m. a sort of hard sugar prepared from the pre-
ceding.

तवस् तवस्, आस्, आस्, अस् (fr. rt. 2. तु), Ved.
strong, powerful, courageous, efficacious, energetic;
an epithet of Rudra, the Maruts, Indra, Parjanya,
Agni, Pūṣan; (आस्), m. power, strength, courage;
[cf. प्र-तवस्.]
—तवस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved.
powerful, strong, an epithet of Soma.

तवस्य, अम्, n., Ved. strength, efficacy; courage;
(Sāy.) an oblation which increases the strength.

तवागा (fr. तवा, a derivative of rt. 2. तु, and गो?),
an epithet of a bull; (but in the Pada-pāṭha this
word is not considered as a compound, and by Sāy.
it is said to mean) of great strength.

तविष, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. powerful, strong, ener-
getic, efficacious; courageous; (अस्), m. the ocean,
sea; heaven, paradise; (ई), f. power, strength, violence,
courage, (inst. plur. तविषीभिस्, powerfully, violently);
the earth; a river; N. of a daughter of Indra; (अम्),
n. power, strength.
—तविषी-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved.
powerful, violent, epithet of the winds.
—तविषी-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. powerful, strong, an epithet
of Indra.

तवीष, अस्, m. the ocean; heaven; gold; (ई),
f., N. of a daughter of Indra; [cf. तविष.]

ताविष ताविष, अस्, ई, m. f. the ocean;
heaven or paradise; gold; [cf. तविष.]

तावीष, अस्, m. the ocean; heaven or paradise;
gold; (ई), f. a river; the earth; N. of a daughter
of Indra; N. of a daughter of the moon (?); [cf.
तवीष.]

तविष्य, nom. A., Ved. तविष्यते, &c., to be
strong or violent, have courage.
तविष्या, f., Ved. violence, force.

तवीयस् or तव्यस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of त-
वस्), stronger, very strong, powerful, rich; (generally
found in the phrase तवसस् तवीयान्, stronger than
the strong.)

1. तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. powerful, strong, grown
strong. (For 2. तव्य see below.)

तव्य 2. तव्य, a कृत् affix by means of which
the future passive participle is formed from roots.
तवारिसाण तवारिसाण, N. of a place.
तविपुला त-विपुला, f. a particular metre.
तावकीन, अस्, आ or ई (?), अम्, thine.

तावत् तावत्, आन्, अती, अत् (fr. the pronom.
base 2. त; correlative of यावत्), so great, so large,
so much, so far, so long, so many, such (e. g. ता-
वन्तस् तण्डुलाः, so many rice-grains; यावता
क्षणेन तावता, after what time, in that time;
यावन्ति तस्य द्वीपस्य वस्तूनि तावन्त्य् उपने-
तव्यानि, whatever are the commodities of that
island, so many are to be brought); तावता, ind. in
the mean time, during that time; to that extent;
तावत्, ind. so much, so greatly, to such an extent,
in such a number, so far, so long, in that time
(correlatively to यावत्, e. g. यावत् — तावत्, as long
as — so long; when — then; यावत् त्रयस् ते जीवेयुस्
तावन् नान्यं समाचरेत्, as long as those three
live, so long he must perform no other duty), mean-
[]
while, in the mean time, (often connected with या-
वत् and a negative, e. g. तावच् छोभते^1 मूर्खो
यावत् किञ्चिन् न भाषते, so long a fool shines as
long as he says nothing; or with omission of the
negative, e. g. शोषयिष्याम्य् आत्मानं तावद्
यावन् मे प्राप्तम् ब्राह्मण्यम्, so long I will
emaciate myself as long as, i. e. until I have obtained
the state of a Brāhman); at once, now, just, (often
connected rather redundantly with an imperative or
with a potential or the verb अर्ह्, e. g. गच्छ तावत्
or गच्छेस् तावत्, go now; तत् तावद् वाक्यं
क्षन्तुम् अर्हसि, deign now to pardon that speech);
indeed, really, truly, well, (as an emphatic particle,
or to express assent, e. g. दृढस् तावद् बन्धः,
the knot is tight I must admit; गता तावत्, she
is indeed gone; sometimes connected in this sense
with the particle एव, e. g. विक्रयस् तावद् एव सः,
it is really a sale.) न तावत्, not at all; not yet
(e. g. न तावद् दृश्यते सूर्यः, the sun is not
yet visible); इतस् तावत्, away then! just come hither;
मा तावत्, by no means, God forbid! यावत् — द्विस्-
तावत्, as long — twice so long. According to the
lexicographers तावत् may imply measure, limitation,
totality, restriction, surprise, emphasis, &c.; [cf. Lat.
tantus fr. tavantus; Gr. τόσος, τῆμος.]
—तावच्-
छत (˚वत्-श˚), अस्, ई, अम्, a measure containing
so many hundreds.
—तावच्-छस् (तावत्-शस्), ind.,
Ved. in so many ways, so manifoldly.
—तावत्-कालम्,
ind. for so long a period, for such a time.
—तावत्-
कृत्वस्, ind. so many times.
—तावत्-फल, अस्, आ,
अम्, having such results.
—तावद्-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्,
having so many qualities.
—तावद्-द्वयस, अस्, ई,
अम्, measuring so much, so long, &c.
—तावद्-धा,
ind. in that number, in such a number; so many
times, so often.
—तावद्-वर्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, so
many years old.
—तावद्-व्यक्त, (in alg.) a known
number annexed to an unknown quantity.
—तावन्-
मात्र, अस्, ई, अम्, just so much, just so many.
—तावन्-मान, अस्, आ, अम्, measuring so much.
[1] Correction submitted by SergeA on 20161201. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/322, batch 303.
तावत्; add — just a little.

तावतिक, अस्, आ, अम्, bought for so much, worth
so much, of so great value; [cf. तावत्क.]

तावतिथ, अस्, ई, अम्, the so manieth, such a one
(of a number).

तावत्क, अस्, आ, अम्, bought for so much, worth
so much, of so much value, &c.; [cf. तावतिक.]

तावुरि तावुरि, इस्, m. (borrowed fr. the
Gr. ταῦρος), the sign of the Zodiac Taurus.
